# Oven Launcher 0.3.7

Single Windows EXE for Oven SMP. Official project website: https://ovensmp.pro
SHA-256: e41f6fb201ec61a3cbb1cb57a9dd8f8f5071938cffbea8f54c78c12ac43e6401

GitHub is the primary artifact source. Approved runtime and modpack files use an authenticated, device-signed API fallback on transient GitHub failures. Minecraft and other unmirrored official downloads remain at their original sources. This is not a complete offline Minecraft distribution.

Update authenticity is verified by the launcher's embedded RSA key. This executable has no Windows Authenticode publisher certificate. Do not disable Windows protection to install it. Third-party notices are included inside the EXE and alongside it here. No passwords, signing keys, settings overrides, player data or Minecraft game binaries are included.
